body.message:
The 1BR at Orchid Creek Beach is AED 7,000/month, all-inclusive. That covers water, electricity, and internet, so nothing extra to pay beyond that.

It's a bit above your range, but given everything is included, the actual out-of-pocket is quite lean. We can't go below AED 6,300 on this one, and even that would need approval from our side.

Want me to check if that's doable for your April 1 dates?
